timeline.evidenceText: The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.
and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,
His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.
Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;
and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to Yahweh, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.

In the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, Azariah the son of Obed, Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into a covenant with him.
Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the ruler of the house, and Elkanah who was next to the king.
Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.
of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;

definitions.short: Zicri , the name of twelve Israelites
definitions.full: H2147. Zikri זִכְרִי proper name, masculine ᵐ5 Ζεχρει , Ζαχρι , etc., except as below: — 1 a Reubenite 1Chr 27:16 . 2 a Judahite 2Chr 17:16 . 3 Levites : a. Exod 6:21 (P). b. 1Chr 26:25 . c. an Asaphite 1Chr 9:15 || Neh 11:17 where read זכרי (for זַבְדִּי , q. v. ); compare also below זַכּוּר 3b. 4. a priest Neh 12:17 ( ᵐ5 L Ζαχαριας ). 5 Benjamites : a. 1Chr 8:19 . b. 1Chr 8:23 . c. 1Chr 8:27 . d. Neh 11:9 . 6 father of a captain in Jehoiada's time 2Chr 23:1 ( ᵐ5 Ζαχαρια , ᵐ5 L Ζεχρι ). 7 mighty man of Ephraim 2Chr 28:7 ( ᵐ5 Ἐζεχρει , ᵐ5 L Ζαχαριας ).
